findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306. 

A small amount of slime/mold is observed on the underside of the ice chute of the fountain drink machine. The inspector wiped the area to show the PIC. Ensure that this is maintained clean at all times moving forward.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306. 

A piece of the bag that rice comes in was observed in a cooked and portioned section of rice on the cook line. The PIC was shown and removed the item during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all Ready-To-Eat foods are protected from physical contaminants at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

1) Multiple dishes on the drying/storage rack in the back are observed with remaining food debris. 2) A spatula and a knife on the magnetic rack in the cook line are observed with remaining food debris on them. More items were found later by the corporate inspectors in the facility during this inspection. All items were shown to the PIC and the items moved back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all dishes are thoroughly cleaned prior to storage and use.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed queso at 57F (probed) and lime juice at 58F (probed) in front reach-in cooler. The queso which had been in the cooler for over 4 hours was discarded during the inspection. The remaining queso had been put in the cooler within an hour, so it was immediately put back into the walk-in cooler. Ensure that all TCS foods are maintained at 41F or less. For cooler repair, refer to line item 33. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Observed the front reach-in cooler was holding TSC foods at 57F and 58F (probed). Ensure that all coolers are holding TSC foods at proper cold-holding temperatures (41F or less). For temperatures refer to line item 22. The follow-up for the front reach-in cooler will be on 07/11/2024.

4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed loose floor tiles with dirt/debris in the gaps by the back hand-sink. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained in good repair.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The corner covering above the mop sink is pulling away from the wall and is in need of resealing. Reseal to the wall prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to don gloves without washing hands. Education conducted and the PIC is instructed to ensure that all employees wash their hands at appropriate times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple knives on the magnetic rack next to the prep area are observed to still be soiled. They appear to have not been completely cleaned when ran through the wash cycle. PIC was consulted and the items moved to dish for re-cleaning.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. 

A container of adobe is observed with a date marking indicating that it should have been discarded on 6/13/23. PIC was consulted and the container discarded during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

An employee was observed to wash hands, use a paper towel to turn off the faucet and then use the same paper towel to dry their hands. Proper hand washing was discussed and it was emphasized that hands should be protected from recontamination after washing has taken place. Violation corrected through education.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to handle money, scratch their nose and then don gloves without hand washing. Food handling/prep was conducted at this time. Hands should be washed immediately before gloves are put on. Education conducted to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Almost all RTE items (salsas, sour cream, etc) in the walk-in cooler observed without date-markings. PIC stated that label printer has not been functioning properly. CORRECTED— Since all items were opened/prepared yesterday or today (per PIC), foods will not be discarded. Label items with the dates they were opened/prepared and use/discard within 7 days.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Outlet cover plate observed missing above the back prep counter. Replace so that wall is sealed and smooth/easily cleanable (drywall is protected from moisture).
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. [C]

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Steak observed in cookline hot holding at 130F, probed. CORRECTED— Steak was reheated to 165F and returned to hot holding for service.
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. [P]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed handling a cellphone with gloved hands, then preparing food (handling shredded cheese) without washing hands or changing gloves. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC and provided education.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  [P]

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Single service forks observed with eating-ends up, resulting in contamination of the food contact portion when customers pick up a fork. Both staff and customers were observed handling the eating-ends of forks without clean hands/gloves. CORRECTED— Provided education & discussed with PIC. Utensils must be stored to prevent contamination of food contact surfaces.
4-904.11: (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Chlorine sanitizer at 10 ppm at the dish machine. Provide 50ppm to 200ppm chlorine concentration. PIC requested service to address low sanitizer concentration. Employees will use the 3 compartment sink until dish machine is dispensing the correct concentration of sanitizer.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114 (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the 2017 FDA Food Code or on the maufacturer's label. (P)

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed rice being stored in several containers without labels. Ensure that when a product is removed from its bulk container that it is labeled. Product labeled during the inspection. 
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed a box of sour cream being stored on top of a trash can. Employee was advised that this was not proper as trash cans are meant for waste and should not be used as holding surfaces for food or their containers. Box was moved during the inspection and the rest of the sour cream removed to eliminate movement of the box causing more cross contamination.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a sanitizer bucket with the rags not fully submerged in sanitizer solution. Sanitizer solution was added to the bucket during inspection.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following walls and attached fixtures to be in disrepair: 1) The hand sink next to the ice machine has caulking that has separated from the wall. 2) The four compartment sink in the rear of the facility has caulking that is separating, as well as has excessive mold growth. 3) Observed multiple holes in the wall around the mop sink and along the back wall next to the back door. Repair all walls so they are smooth and easily cleanable. Recaulk the sinks.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed the an employee on the cook line touch a utensil, then place her hands into the ready to eat cheese. The cheese was noted to be at 64F with no time marking as well. Cheese was discarded by manager.
750-160(a) Food shall be prepared with the least possible manual contact, using suitable utensils and using surfaces that have been cleaned, rinsed, and sanitized to prevent cross-contamination.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the seal on the cooler with alcohol to be pulling away from the door. Non-food contact surfaces must be smooth and easily cleanable. Repair the seal on the door.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the men's restroom to be without a covered receptacle. Ensure that all restrooms have soap, hot and cold water, disposable paper towels or hand dryer, and a covered receptacle. 
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed some of the brackets to the shelves and some of the wire shelves in the dish area and above the pre table across from the walk in cooler to be rusty. Replace brackets and shelving as needed. Shelves are on order.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed a soiled knife stored on the magnetic strip with clean knives. Store utensils clean and dry.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed soiled linens to be stored on the ground in the dumpster area and flies to be swarming this area. Apparently facility just got a new dumpster and is in the process of getting a covered container for the storage of soiled linens in this area. Store linens in a covered container to reduce pests in this area.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed two small measuring spoons to be stored with the handle in contact with the spice on the counter near the prep sink. Scoops were adjusted during inspection to have the handles up and out of the spice. Always store scoops with the handles extended up and out of the food.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floor drain behind the water heater to be soiled. Clean the floor drain.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the front hand sink to be separated from the wall. Re-caulk hand sink to the wall. 2) Observed the caulk at the three compartment sink to be missing and soiled in areas. Replace caulk. 3) Observed the hand sink in the men's restroom to be separated from the wall. Re-caulk hand sink to wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed that two bulk containers of raw rice were not labeled with the common name of product.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.
Label these containers with the common name of product inside.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed that there were serving containers stored in the bulk container of rice product.
750-280 To avoid unnecessary manual contact with food, suitable dispensing utensils shall be used by employees or provided to consumers who serve themselves.
Avoid placing clean pans in bulk containers, whether they are used for scoops for the product, or used to transport product to another area or operation of the food establishment; keep these pans stored externally of the bulk container.
CORRECTED = Pans were removed from bulk container.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed that the nozzles and backsplash of the drink dispenser in the dining area had some splash residue. 
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
Clean this equipment as necessary.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
750.1100-All equipment shall be properly drained.
Observed that the discharge line from the cooling unit located next to the cash register is causing a pool of standing water because it is not reaching the floor drain. 
Repair cooler so as not to cause standing water.
CORRECTED= Drain line was moved closer to floor drain.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed that there was a container of sour cream in the walk in that was not labeled as to the date that it was removed from manufacturer packaging.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.
Label PHF as to time and sate of preparation.
Observed that the bulk containers holding dry rice were not labeled as to the product inside.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.
Label bulk food containers with the common name of product.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed a container of freshly sliced lettuce that was stored on a shelf uncovered. Observed a container of sliced onions in the walk in cooler that were uncovered. Also observed that the sliced lemons at the customer drink station were stored uncovered.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. 
Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed that the rear hand sink was non-functional, and had a sign posted not to use it.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
Repair hand sink.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The coving at the entrance door to the walk in cooler is still broken.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Repair coving.
**REPEAT Violation**

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed there are two light bulbs in the vent hood that are burned out.
750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 20 foot-candles of light on all food preparation surfaces and at equipment or utensil washing areas.
Replace light bulbs.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
Observed an employee's personal drink in a food preparation area, during food prep.
750-530 Employees shall not eat or drink in food prep areas.
CORRECTED= drink was removed from area.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.
Observed a container of sliced onions in the walk in cooler that were not labeled with the time and date of preparation.
Label all PHF with the time and date of preparation.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
Observed that prep cooler #1 did not contain a thermometer. 
Provide thermometers in all refrigeration units.
CORRECTED= A thermometer was placed in unit.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.
Observed bags of raw onions stored on the floor of the walk in cooler. 
Properly store and protect food.
CORRECTED= Bags were hung on hooks of the shelving in the walk in cooler.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Observed that there is a chipped coving tile adjacent to the door of the walk in cooler.
Repair this piece of damaged coving.
(REPEAT Violation)
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
Observed that there is some spillage under the shelves in the carry-out prep area.
Clean the floors.
